purpose: Prove a CROSS-ORIGIN iframe is skipped honestly - contentDocument throws, the walker catches, captures nothing, and does not crash the rest of the page's capture - while OPAQUE_JS names the embed so the blind spot is a ledger row rather than silence.
targeted_defect: None (regression guard). Pins the fail-honest branch at inventory_js.py:657 and the cross_origin_iframe detector at :692-698. A future change that swallowed the whole walk on a SecurityError would lose the main-frame controls too.
lane_note: Playwright only: jsdom has no true cross-origin isolation, so a second origin cannot be simulated faithfully. Running this in jsdom would prove nothing about the branch under test.
